An issue exists in `tests/kernel/mem_protect/sys_sem/src/main.c` in `test_sys_sem_take_multiple`: the priorities assigned to the low-priority and high-priority helper threads are inverted. In Zephyr, lower numerical priority values denote higher thread priority, so `sem_take_multiple_low_prio_helper` must be created with `K_PRIO_PREEMPT(3)` and `sem_take_multiple_high_prio_helper` with `K_PRIO_PREEMPT(1)`.
